meta.name: financial-statement-analysis
meta.description: Reads a set of financial statements and establishes what changed and why — fluctuation analysis against prior period and against budget, profitability, liquidity, solvency and efficiency ratios, benchmarking, and the non-GAAP measures presented alongside them. Use this to interpret results, review a counterparty's or target's financials, diagnose a deteriorating trend, explain a variance to someone who will act on it, or test whether an adjusted number is honest.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析财务报表,解释变动原因与财务健康度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想快速看懂一家公司的财务报表并发现异常变动。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze financial statements to uncover changes and assess financial health.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to interpret financial statements and explain variances to decision-makers.

howto.what: Claude会读取财务报表，对比前期和预算找变化原因，计算盈利、流动性、偿债等指标并与同行比较；还会检验调整后指标，并诊断恶化趋势。
howto.when: 当你提供一套财务报表（资产负债表、利润表、现金流量表），并要求解释差异、审查财务、诊断趋势等时触发。

say.text: 对比本季和上季的利润表，找出变化原因。
say.note: Claude会做波动分析并解释驱动因素。

say.text: 算这家公司的偿债能力和现金转换周期，并与同行比较。
say.note: Claude会计算相关比率并给出趋势和对比。

say.text: 分析报表里调整后的EBITDA，看加回了什么。
say.note: Claude会核查调整项并指出是否合理。

howto.what_en: Claude reads financial statements, compares vs prior period and budget, computes key solvency/liquidity/profitability ratios, benchmarks, and tests non-GAAP adjustments. It diagnoses deteriorating trends top-down.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide financial statements and ask Claude to explain changes, review financials, or diagnose a trend.

say_en.text: Compare this quarter's income to last quarter's and explain the change.
say_en.note: Claude will run fluctuation analysis and identify drivers.

say_en.text: Calculate solvency ratios and cash conversion cycle, benchmark vs peers.
say_en.note: Claude will compute ratios with trend and comparison.

say_en.text: Check the adjusted EBITDA in these statements and tell me what was added back.
say_en.note: Claude will reconcile and assess the adjustments.
